value.rationale: For fixed-radius zeros, boundary covering-speed L2 variance measures phase distortion of the associated n-fold circle map. The all-degree positive Hessian and its sharp, radius-dependent soft mode distinguish angular perturbation mechanisms and force an unavoidable transition; this is a motivated structural stability invariant, not a routine restatement of a known extreme-value bound or a small isolated numerical gain.
